notes: Test specifications only: no implementation, scans, environments, or cloud resources were run. FIPS claims require exact NIST CMVP validation and deployed approved use evidence.

cases.title: Mutual TLS transport authentication
cases.assertion_or_oracle: Scoped direct mTLS certificate chain and peer identity observed
cases.limitation_or_negative_control: Missing client authentication must be reported

cases.title: Proxy TLS termination and re-encryption
cases.assertion_or_oracle: Two distinct TLS sessions, plaintext-at-proxy capability; hop-by-hop not E2EE

cases.title: Plaintext internal backend
cases.assertion_or_oracle: Transport from proxy to backend observed/verified without encryption

cases.title: Certificate and issuer rotation
cases.limitation_or_negative_control: Old certificate retired, status and timestamps clear

cases.title: CBOM discovery and CycloneDX export
cases.assertion_or_oracle: Schema-valid 1.7 CBOM, stable asset IDs, accurate coverage

cases.title: Unsupported FIPS marketing assertion
cases.assertion_or_oracle: Vendor claim alone never marks verified validated use
cases.limitation_or_negative_control: Requires CMVP ID and validation source

cases.title: FIPS module mismatch/approved mode missing
cases.assertion_or_oracle: Certificate/status vs actual module/config mismatch or inconclusive

cases.title: Synthetic key lifecycle and denied read
cases.assertion_or_oracle: Key rotation metadata and denied test identity; provenance
cases.limitation_or_negative_control: Synthetic key only; no key export

cases.title: Scanner privileges/visibility gap
cases.assertion_or_oracle: Inconclusive with missing source and method

cases.title: Load balancer to service/database encryption path
cases.assertion_or_oracle: Document all in-scope hops and TLS termination

cases.title: S3 SSE-KMS and KMS permissions
cases.assertion_or_oracle: At-rest encryption config and synthetic allow/deny test

cases.title: Managed cryptographic module FIPS validation
cases.assertion_or_oracle: Specific CMVP module/version/status plus use evidence

cases.title: ACM renewal and endpoint mapping
cases.assertion_or_oracle: Diff cert metadata/actual bound endpoint and validate chain

cases.title: Application Gateway to App Service/Azure SQL
Key Vault and Blob key permissions

cases.limitation_or_negative_control: No keys or secrets in reports
